title: Across-phonation timing–amplitude covariance: an inconclusive Parkinson voice transfer test
abstract: Across-phonation jitter–shimmer covariance did not establish improved Oxford-to-Istanbul Parkinson prediction beyond mean and dispersion measures: external Brier change -0.000376 (joint bootstrap95% interval -0.026948 to 0.000589); major feature shifts and saturated predictions limit interpretation.
